artist: Alan Bergman / Marilyn Bergman / Marvin Hamlisch
title: THE WAY WE WERE
lyrics_synced:
[00:07.25] Mem'ries light the corners of my mind,
[00:19.36] misty watercolor mem'ries
[00:26.59] of the way we were.
[00:35.68] Scattered pictures of the smiles we left behind,
[00:48.43] smiles we give to one another
[00:55.70] for the way we were.
[01:06.59] Can it be that it was all so simple then
[01:13.42] or has time rewritten ev'ry line?
[01:20.70] If we had the chance to do it all again,
[01:26.27] tell me would we?
[01:30.89] Could we?
[01:34.45] Mem'ries may be beautiful and yet,
[01:46.63] what's too painful to remember,
[01:53.87] we simply forget.
[02:04.77] Can it be that it was all so simple then
[02:11.60] or has time rewritten ev'ry line?
[02:18.88] If we had the chance to do it all again,
[02:24.46] tell me would we?
[02:29.07] Could we?
[02:32.69] Mem'ries may be beautiful and yet,
[02:44.81] what's too painful to remember,
[02:52.09] we simply forget.
[03:00.44] So it's the laughter we will remember,
[03:14.05] whenever we remember
[03:21.50] the way we were,
[03:28.77] the way we were,
[03:36.04] the way we were.%-%+%-%+%-%+%-%+
